Messages.Author: beslin igor
Messages.Body:
Name: Lunatic Eruption
[SW:R, Third:R]
Cardtype: Action
Cost: 2 blood
Discipline: Dementation
[dem]  Put this card on any ready minion. During his or her minion phase, the minion with this card must enter combat with a ready minion controlled by his or her prey as a  action (unless the minion must hunt). Any minion may burn this card as an action.
[DEM] As above, and the minion taking the action to burn this card takes 1 unpreventable damage when this card is burned.

What happen if minion with Lunatic Eruption unlock after enter combat? him must enter combat again or can chose another action?

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
